title: How to Start a Garden
description: Step-by-step tutorial video with clear visual instructions. Uses neutral preset with slide transitions, top-tag captions, and calm background music.
script:
Today I'll show you how to start your own vegetable garden. [Visual: gardening tools spread] [Transition: slide]
First, choose a sunny spot with good soil drainage. [Visual: sunny garden soil bed] [Transition: slide]
Prepare the soil by removing weeds and adding compost. [Visual: composting organic soil] [Transition: slide] [Kinetic: on]
Plant your seeds at the recommended depth. [Visual: planting seeds soil hands] [Transition: slide]
Water gently and keep the soil moist. [Visual: watering can watering plants] [Transition: slide]
In a few weeks you'll see sprouts emerging. [Visual: green sprouts growing soil] [Transition: slide]
Harvest your vegetables when they're ripe and enjoy. [Visual: fresh vegetables harvest] [Transition: fade] [Grade: warm]
